request_layout.C_D2_participant: d2 state, body2/frame4; state0 NOT_READY,1 READY,2 SHOP_LIST. No name/room/source/physical fields. Server applies to requesting session. Exact parser rejects other state or trailing bytes in ROOM.
request_layout.C_D2_owner: d2 only, body1/frame3; OWNER_START, not implicit default state0. Same opcode as later server START but opposite direction/phase.
request_layout.phase_parse_order: ClientSession.setReady returns immediately outsideROOM before payload parsing; normal handle routesC_D2 to setReady. No malformed-payload CE/ready ACK promise.

authority_conditions.ordinary_member: ClientSession phaseROOM/currentRoom identifies prior join; GameHub.setReady explicitly checks room exists, !session.observer, !room.battleStarted and battle-scene rules. It does NOT directly check room.members.contains(session), fresh auth/selected/source or nonzeroRoom; these are normal joined-session invariants, not new admission gates. Do not model it as arbitrary member authority.
authority_conditions.owner: requestOwnerStart requires room!=null and room.owner==requester before calling setReady(true). Owner identity is GameHub session object, not display alias alone. No ability to ready peers through this request.
authority_conditions.nonowner_opcode_only: returns ReadyUpdate(false,NONE) without mutating hub.room.ready; ClientSession then sets its local ready=false and publishes ownD1 0 to room peers. If the nonowner had been hub-ready, that set entry is not removed by this rejection. This is source/actual IL only, not a wire-qualified benign no-op or an authorized fix.
authority_conditions.observer_or_missing_room: hub returns false/NONE; ClientSession projects requested2 as shop state2, otherwise0. Existing room members may receive that state; missing room member snapshot empty. Source/IL only.
authority_conditions.start_latch: No separate owner-start latch. Last participant D201 can initiate countdown when owner/others are already ready. Opcode-only owner control merely requests own ready=true under ownership check. This alternate order is source/IL only.

ready_state_machine.requested0: remove own hub ready entry; localreadyfalse; publishD1 0; if activeCOUNTDOWN no longer allReady, commitWAITING/value0/deadline0 and transitionCANCELLED then publishE1 00.
ready_state_machine.requested1_waiting: add own ready entry; repeated1 before COUNTDOWN remainsready, not toggle. If enoughPlayers, nonemptycombatants and ready.containsAll(combatants) and matchWAITING: commitCOUNTDOWN/value3/next=now+1second, returnSTARTED. Otherwise returnNONE.
ready_state_machine.requested1_countdown_already_ready: toggle own ready tofalse, remove entry; insufficientallReady cancelsCOUNTDOWN; publishD1 0 thenE1 00. Applies to owner opcode-only true too. Source/IL only.
ready_state_machine.requested2: hub booleanrequested=false; remove ready; localreadyfalse but publishD1 2 (shop/list), thenE1 00 if countdown cancelled. Do not treat2 as readytrue.
ready_state_machine.minimums: nativeRosterReady ordinary non-Siege/PetRace returns true; nonempty actual combatants and all ready are explicit. No universal two-human minimum guard here. Enforced PetRace checks count vs rules.minimumPlayers; enforced Siege checks per-force bounds, includes virtual players. Mode-specific preparation/matchbegin errors remain possible before first WORLD.
ready_state_machine.three_phases: ClientSession staysROOM during ready/countdown; GameHub.match WAITING/COUNTDOWN independent; Native selfD1 1 typically transitions numeric2→3 and non1 back2 (except6), qualified alias/private dependencies required. These are not interchangeable.

partial_and_race_boundaries: S_D1/E1 member writes are not caught inside setReady: one IOException can abort later recipients and E1 transition send after hub/local state already committed. Actual run-finally may later disconnect; no atomic rollback inferred.

countdownWork commits state and collects room snapshots under lock, sends after unlocking. Another ready/cancel request can race a queued tick/start; original lacks a wire generation/timestamp or publication barrier. Source/IL only; do not infer freshness from global CaptureLog order.

countdownTickSafely outer Throwable catch logs recovery; failed tick/prepare/start dispatch can abort rest of collected work. A committed start is not guaranteed to retry nexttick or deliver WORLD to every peer. No dynamic partial-failure proof.

successfulD1 1 confirms projected ownready output in this route, not totalready/start authority/native phase readiness. E1 03 means transition publication, not completed preparation or WORLD admission.

native countdown UI does not establish server timing precision:1second deadline with250ms polling and scheduling drift; no exact arrival interval or guaranteed countdown minimum display duration proved.

COUNTDOWN cancellation may come from request or scheduler recheck; no need newfixture to tabulate both. E1 00 received after other updates needs per-peer arrival policy and current-room scope; do not guess implicit local roster correction.

finite_publish_order: GH lock commits ready/match/value/deadline; CS localready; per-peer ownalias D1; then STARTED E103/CANCELLED E100/NONE noE1. Uncaught send may abort after commits.
